caption: A wasm rule is pinned to the hash of the module you registered. If the file changes, the daemon refuses that rule at its next load and badges it here: it stays in your ruleset but can never fire. Only that rule is refused — the one above it keeps working, so a tampered module cannot switch off the rest of your policy.

runs.text: The primary way to author auto-approvals: a sandboxed decide(ctx) function with the full power of code. Scaffold a starter project and open it in your editor.
Or add a simple declarative rule. Rules fire before the consent prompt. Deny rules win; most-specific approve wins ties.
